description: Impact is the Kenyan water regulator's yearly public report on the performance of the country's water services sector. It ranks the licensed water service providers on nine key indicators that are part of their binding minimum service levels: water coverage, sanitation coverage, unaccounted-for water, water quality, hours of supply, metering, revenue collection efficiency, operation and maintenance cost coverage and staff productivity. The Water Services Regulatory Board (WASREB) produces it; issues run from 2010-2011 (issue 5) to 2024-2025 (issue 18), and tables from the 2014 to 2017 reports, general data on 88 utilities serving 12.07 million people in 2016/17 and a creditworthiness index were republished by Majidata on HDX. Coverage is national, every licensed utility in Kenya. The reports are free PDFs on the WASREB site and the HDX tables are free XLSX files under CC BY. Caveats: recent years are in PDF reports, not machine-readable tables, and the HDX tables stop at 2017. Simulation uses: utility-level service levels, losses and finances for capacity planning and resilience of urban water supply. Related record: WASREB's MajiData georeferenced system (data-wasreb-majidata-kenya-water-sanitation-gis).
